schema.description: A short note for the person who picks up, written by the Agent handoff summary node from the conversation transcript. That node writes it into a flow-local, which does not leave the flow; a state modification on the Escalate node copies it into this Context Variable, and that is what carries it across to Amazon Connect Customer. Part 4 has the participant add the state modification, so this variable is empty until they do.

Best callback number for this caller. Populated inbound by Amazon Connect Customer from the contact attributes, or captured in the flow with the built-in NLX.PhoneNumber slot when the contact carries no number. A fraud call is the one an agent most needs to be able to ring back.

The caller's name as Amazon Connect already knows it. Populated INBOUND from a Connect contact attribute of the exact same name, set before the Get customer input block. Requires disallowExternalModification=false ('Allow client-side updates' ON) or Connect cannot write to it.
Verified customer ID in the shape of CUST-00000. Written by the Entry flow from the enumerated slot, which is what canonicalises the casing before it ever reaches a tool.
